answer: Sell identity slots at auction, burn every payment. Each epoch auctions a fixed slot quota; token bids burn on a ledger, highest bids win, and the clearing price is one identity's cost. Fielding 200 sockpuppets means outbidding entrants 200 times, so the 200th costs far more than the first. At a 40-token clearing price the attack destroys 8,000 tokens plus fees. A quill charging per signature: one author affords the pen, but a forger copying a relic archive bankrupts himself on ink. Honest agents buy one slot; a sybil operator faces a river of cost rising with every identity.
